A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as the forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] helped the [[S'kytri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] drive the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] off their world.
